metadata.description:
This POAP commemorates the 21st Olson Family Vacation. The Olson Family has made a tradition of spending time every year together. Planning is rotated through each daughter of Don & Kaye Olson. This POAP was delivered directly to each member of the Olson Family in Webster, Wisconsin. This year was orchestrated by Corinne and Denny. 

The locations include: 

1. Grand Superior Lodge — October 2004 
2. Wisconsin Dells — October 2005 
3. Lanesboro — May 2006 
4. Lundeen Cabin — June 2007 
5. Alexandria — May 2008 
6. Brainerd Lake House — August 2009 
7. Chequamegon — September 2010 
8. Barn on the Bluff — May 2011 
9. Aitkin — September 2012 
10. Lanesboro — May 2013 
11. Grand View Lodge — October 2014 
12. Hibbing — September 2015 
13. Blue Heron Lodge — October 2016 
14. Nicaboyne Lake — October 2017 
15. Park Rapids — October 2018 
16. Amery — August 2019 
17. Madison Lake — October 2020 
18. Birchwood Acres — September 2021 
19. River Lodge — November 2022 
20. Fergus Falls — March 2023
21. Webster — May 2024
metadata.name: Olson Family Vacation 2024
